Fresh temporary import files match source hashes.

No production/common/user locator path is mutated.
No checkpoint promotion or locator update is performed.
No training, eval, or model mutation is performed.
Evidence states scoped core asset lifecycle proof only.
Row16 remains not accepted until separate review.
fail_criteria_ru: Source root, checkpoint, or manifest missing.
Any source hash differs from expected Row14 staged-export hash.
Any backup/export, share readback, or fresh-import hash differs from source.
Fresh-load harness is missing, unreviewed, or run with a different unapproved command.
Fresh-load fails from the temporary root.
Fresh-load readback does not confirm machine/domain/version/trainedPairCount.
Any production/common/user locator, promoted checkpoint, or shared product state is touched.
Training, eval, promotion, or locator update is performed.
Cleanup cannot prove temporary state stayed inside Row16 evidence.
Executor cannot prove a path is temporary and inside the current Row16 run folder.
